question.content: 請給我一個供4人份量的'肉醬千層麵'的烹飪食譜，以及一個供2人份量的'凱撒沙拉'的烹飪食譜。

function_schema.name: get_cooking_recipe
function_schema.description: Retrieve the cooking recipe for a specified food item.

dish_name.description: Name of the food dish for which recipe is required.

serving_size.description: Number of people for which the dish will be prepared.

model_result_raw: [get_cooking_recipe(dish_name='肉酱千层面', serving_size=4), get_cooking_recipe(dish_name='凯撒沙拉', serving_size=2)]
